sentences.text: .2. The brief facts of the case is that the land bearing Sy.No.31 measuring 3 acres 15 guntas of Kembhattanahalli village, Uttarahalli Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluka has been acquired for the purpose of BMICP.
Preliminary notification was issued on 02.06.1999 and 29.01.2003.
The final notification was issued on 24.06.2003 and 05.07.2003.
The L.A.O. has fixed the compensation of Rs.12,39,633/-.
As title documents were not produced, L.A.O. has referred the matter to this Court and has deposited a sum of Rs.12,39,633/-.
The said amount has been kept in F.D. in Syndicate Bank, City Market branch, Bengaluru.
After receipt of reference, this court issued notice to both parties.
The claimants have entered appearance through their counsels.
.4. Claimant No.2 M. Srinivas has filed claim statement stating that he is suffering from ill health, as such, he has executed a Special Power of Attorney in favour of his wife Smt. Prema Srinivas.

It is stated that originally the property bearing Sy. No.22/1, 23/1, 14/1 and Syno. 31 measuring to an extent of 7 acres 1 guntas of land situated at Kembhattanahalli village, Uttarahalli Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluka belongs to Smt. Nagamma, which is her absolute property.
The claimant No.1 and 2 i.e., Shankarappa and M. Srinivas and the claimants 3 and 4 i.e., Susheelamma and Gowramma are children of said Nagamma.

sentences.text: It is stated that the said Nagamma has executed a Will dated 14.11.1984 bequeathing all her properties in favour of claimants 1 and 2 i.e., late. Shankarappa and M. Srinivas.

The property bearing Sy.No.31 which is subject matter of this proceedings, L.A.C. No.217/2010 measuring to an extent of 7 acres 1 guntas is one among the properties bequeathed under the said Will in favour of claimants 1 and 2.

It is stated that subsequently the said Nagamma died on 18.06.1987, as such, by virtue of the said Will dated 14.11.1984 executed by Nagamma the claimant No.1 and 2 have succeeded as absolute owners and in possession and enjoyment of property bearing Sy. No.31 measuring to an extent of 7 acres 1 guntas and consequently the mutation entries came to be effected in favour of the claimants 1 and 2 in IHC No.8/88-89.
It is stated that the claimants 3 and 4 do not have any right, title or interest over the property in question.

It is stated that the claimants 3 and 4 have filed a suit in O.S. No.6498/90 on the file of City Civil Court, at Bengaluru for partition and separate possession claiming  share in the suit schedule properties.
The suit came to be decreed on 07.04.2006.

The Lrs of claimant No.1 and claimant No.2 have preferred an Appeal in RFA No.1627/2006 before the Hon'ble High Court of L.A.C. No.217/2010 Karnataka at Bangalore and the same is pending adjudication.
.6.

sentences.text:
My findings on the above points are as under:
Point No.1: As per decision L.A.C. No.217/2010 Point No.2: As per final order, for the following:
REASONS .13.
Point No.1: The claimant No.4 Smt. Gowramma has been examined as PW.1.

She has stated that she and her sister Susheelamma had filed a suit against their brothers in O.S. No.6498/1990 on the file of the City Civil Court for partition and separate possession of their  share in the suit schedule properties including the property in the reference bearing Sy. No.23/1 measuuring 24 guntas.

She has stated that the claimants 1 and 2 are her brothers and they have expired; that her brothers had suppressed the pendency of the above suit for partition and made encumbrance and they are not binding on her and her sister Susheelamma as the Will dated 14.11.1984 under which they are claiming to have derived title, was negatived by the Court in O.S. No.6498/90; that she and her sister are together entitled for  share in the compensation payable on account of acquisition as per L.A.C. No.217/2010 decree passed in the suit; that her deceased brothers had challenged the decree in RFA No.1627/2006 before the Hon'ble High Court and the same is pending consideration.
.14. In support of her contention, she has produced RTC extract for the year 2021-2022.

From the said document, it is seen that name of KIADB is entered in Col.
No.9 and 12(2).
Ex.P.2 is the judgment in O.S. No.6498/1990.

From the judgment, it is seen that suit has been decreed in part and it is held that the claimants 3 and 4 are entitled for  share each in the plaint schedule properties subject to the calculation of the value of property given to them at the time of their marriage.
From the schedule it is seen that Sy. No.31 is item No.4 of the schedule.
P.3 is the judgment in LAC No.117/2003.
From the judgment, it is seen that land in Sy. No.24/1 measuring 1 acre 19 guntas was acquired.

The Court had allowed the reference in respect of claimant No.1 by his legal representatives and claimants 2,
3 and 4.

It L.A.C. No.217/2010 has been held that they are entitled for 1/4th share each in the compensation amount subject to the decision in RFA No.1626/2006.
.16.
Claimant No.2 though has filed claim statement, he has not entered into the witness box to substantiate his contention.

From the claim statement, it is admitted fact that O.S. No.6498/1990 has been filed by claimants 3 and 4 and against the said judgment, he and his brother claimant No.1 had preferred RFA No.1627/2006.
The evidence of PW.1 stands un-rebutted.
Therefore, I do not find any reason to disbelieve the evidence of PW.1 that they are the joint owners of the property and they are entitled for compensation.
.17. The claimants 1 and 2 have not led their evidence and hence, their claim is rejected.
Accordingly point No.1 is answered partly in the affirmative.

sentences.text:
In view of my finding on point No.1, I proceed to pass the following:
 L.A.C. No.217/2010  O R DE R

The reference made by the respondent/SLAO, KIADB (BMICP),
Bengaluru under Sections 30 and 31(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is hereby partly allowed.

LRs of claimant No.3 are together entitled for 1/4th share and claimant No.4 Smt.
Gowramma is entitled for 1/4th share in the compensation amount in respect of Sy.
No.31 measuring 3 acres 15 guntas of Kembhattanahalli village, Uttarahalli Hobli,
Bengaluru South Taluka, subject to the result in RFA No.1627/2006 pending on the file of the Hon'ble High Court.

The above claimants shall have to execute indemnity bonds with one surety,
undertaking to re-deposit the compensation amount either in this court or in any other court, if ordered to do so, which amount they are going to receive in this case.
The above claimants are entitled to interest under Section 34 of L.A. Act.
The amount already paid by L.A.O., has to be deducted.
L.A.C. No.217/2010  The reference made by the respondent in-respect of claimants 1 and 2 is rejected.
Draw award accordingly.
(Dictated to the Judgment Writer, transcribed by her, revised by me and after corrections, pronounced in open Court on this the 16th day of February, 2023.)
(Sheila B.M.), II Addl. City Civil and Sessions Judge & Spl. Judge, Bengaluru.
